Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.performance

Class PerformanceSnapshot

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.performance.PerformanceSnapshot
public final class PerformanceSnapshot extends Object
Immutable copy of collected performance samples.

Snapshot creation and percentile aggregation allocate memory by design and should happen outside a measured interval. Runtime collection itself uses preallocated primitive buffers.

Since:
2.0.0

  • Constructor Details

    • PerformanceSnapshot

      public PerformanceSnapshot(PerformanceMode requestedMode, PerformanceMode effectiveMode, long totalFrames, int storedFrames, long overwrittenFrames, long[][] durationsNanos, int[][] calls, long invariantViolations, long cubemapCaptureViolations, long unexpectedPassViolations, List<String> diagnostics)
      Creates a snapshot from runtime-owned sample arrays.

      This constructor is public only to bridge the internal recorder package; applications should obtain snapshots from the ziviDomeLive facade.

      Parameters:
      requestedMode - mode requested by the application
      effectiveMode - mode actually used by the recorder
      totalFrames - completed frames since the latest reset
      storedFrames - completed frames retained in the ring buffer
      overwrittenFrames - completed frames overwritten by the ring buffer
      durationsNanos - chronological metric durations indexed by metric ordinal
      calls - chronological metric call counts indexed by metric ordinal
      invariantViolations - total detected render-graph invariant violations
      cubemapCaptureViolations - detected cubemap-capture invariant violations
      unexpectedPassViolations - detected unexpected render-pass violations
      diagnostics - immutable human-readable collection diagnostics

    • PerformanceSnapshot

      public PerformanceSnapshot(PerformanceMode requestedMode, PerformanceMode effectiveMode, long totalFrames, int storedFrames, long overwrittenFrames, long[][] durationsNanos, int[][] calls, long invariantViolations, long cubemapCaptureViolations, long unexpectedPassViolations, List<String> diagnostics, long[][] gpuDurationsNanos, int[][] gpuCalls)
      Creates a snapshot containing CPU samples and delayed GPU elapsed samples. GPU arrays use the same chronological frame indices and metric ordinals as CPU arrays.
      Parameters:
      requestedMode - mode requested by the application
      effectiveMode - mode actually used by the recorder
      totalFrames - completed frames since the latest reset
      storedFrames - completed frames retained in the ring buffer
      overwrittenFrames - completed frames overwritten by the ring buffer
      durationsNanos - chronological CPU metric durations by metric ordinal
      calls - chronological CPU metric call counts by metric ordinal
      invariantViolations - total detected render-graph invariant violations
      cubemapCaptureViolations - detected cubemap-capture invariant violations
      unexpectedPassViolations - detected unexpected render-pass violations
      diagnostics - immutable human-readable collection diagnostics
      gpuDurationsNanos - chronological GPU durations by metric ordinal
      gpuCalls - chronological GPU result counts by metric ordinal
      Since:
      2.0.0

    • PerformanceSnapshot

      public PerformanceSnapshot(PerformanceMode requestedMode, PerformanceMode effectiveMode, long totalFrames, int storedFrames, long overwrittenFrames, long[][] durationsNanos, int[][] calls, long invariantViolations, long cubemapCaptureViolations, long unexpectedPassViolations, List<String> diagnostics, long[][] gpuDurationsNanos, int[][] gpuCalls, GpuTimerPolicy gpuTimerPolicy, GpuTimerBackend gpuTimerBackend, GpuTimerArchitecture gpuTimerArchitecture)
      Creates a snapshot including the GPU timer selection evidence.
      Parameters:
      requestedMode - mode requested by the application
      effectiveMode - mode actually used by the recorder
      totalFrames - completed frames since the latest reset
      storedFrames - completed frames retained in the ring buffer
      overwrittenFrames - completed frames overwritten by the ring buffer
      durationsNanos - chronological CPU durations by metric ordinal
      calls - chronological CPU calls by metric ordinal
      invariantViolations - total render-graph invariant violations
      cubemapCaptureViolations - cubemap-capture invariant violations
      unexpectedPassViolations - unexpected render-pass violations
      diagnostics - immutable collection diagnostics
      gpuDurationsNanos - chronological GPU durations by metric ordinal
      gpuCalls - chronological GPU result counts by metric ordinal
      gpuTimerPolicy - requested GPU timer selection policy
      gpuTimerBackend - effective GPU timer backend
      gpuTimerArchitecture - normalized architecture used during selection
